verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for an error-monitoring SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents a Rollbar command-line tool. The nearby items do not qualify: the REST API, OpenAPI spec, Terraform provider and stdio MCP server are adjacent building blocks or belong to other stories, and rollbar-agent is a file-forwarding agent rather than a user-facing CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
